comment: Real National Weather Service alerts from api.weather.gov/alerts/active, captured 2026-10-28 (public domain). Description and instruction text shortened.

properties.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 28 at 5:32PM MDT until October 28 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
SVREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Otero County in south central New Mexico...

* Until 600 PM MDT.

* At 532 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 9 miles southwest
of Hondo, and is nearly stationary.

HAZARD...60 mph
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 28 at 2:57PM AKDT until October 30 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 40 mph with gusts of 50 to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Anchorage and Eagle River Hillsides, mainly above 1000 feet
elevation.

* WHEN...From 3 PM Thursday to 1 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may resul
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
